goals: Preserve accepted sweet-berry-bush protection for exact ordinary Horses and their current direct Player riders.
Add guarded powdered-snow walkability, solid-from-above collision, and freezing immunity for the same exact ordinary-Horse scope.
scope: Phase 1 ordinary-Horse and direct mounted-Player sweet-berry-bush damage and slowdown protection retained from accepted C2.
Phase 2 exact ordinary-Horse and current direct Player-rider powdered-snow walkability, collision, and freezing protection implemented by C3.

exclusions: General Player immunity, unrelated entities, and all AbstractHorse subclasses beyond the exact ordinary Horse policy.
Global powdered-snow replacement and global damage or movement hooks.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft instance changes, accepted-baseline changes, and Test Instance Manager changes during this migration.

dependencies.reason: Target game version for the preserved vanilla contracts and narrow mixin seams.
Fabric runtime loader declared by the retained C3 implementation.

state.milestone: User-reported external aggregate runtime PASS is bound to exact C3; C3 is accepted in Stack v10 with no Test Slot deployment or slot history, and C2 is retained as rollback/provenance.

current.summary: Protects ordinary Horses and their direct riders from sweet-berry-bush damage.

accepted.summary: Protects ordinary Horses and their direct riders from sweet-berry-bush damage.
